name: Tamás Váradi
bio: Tamás Váradi is a computational linguist at the Hungarian Research Centre for Linguistics. Váradi is the national coordinator of Hungary's participation in the CLARIN language resources infrastructure and co-authored the 2008 CLARIN overview paper.
known_for: Co-author of the CLARIN infrastructure overview
